description.narrative: The project aims at phasing out 895 ODP tons of methyl bromide used in the country with the participation of four implementing agencies: UNIDO, ITALY, SPAIN and CANADA, as follows: UNIDO US$ 5,204,857 <(>&<)> US$ 390 ,364 (7.5% support cost), ITALY US$ 1,000,000 <(>&<)> US$120,000 (13 and 11% support cost), SPAIN US$ 1,600,000 <(>&<)> US$ 186,000 (13 and 11% support cost) and CANADA US$ 1,417,522 <(>&<)> US$ 165,927 (13 and 11% support cost).
